parameters.jsCode: const r=$json; if(!r.policy_id || !r.instruction || !Array.isArray(r.allowed_fields) || !r.output_schema) throw new Error('Invalid AI proposal request'); const locked=['amount','source_id','imported_id','direction','topic','reconciliation_state','cashback_amount']; if(r.allowed_fields.some(f=>locked.includes(f))) throw new Error('AI request includes a locked field'); return [{json:r}];

const req=$('Validate Policy and Allowed Fields').first().json; const proposals=Array.isArray($json.proposals)?$json.proposals:[]; for(const p of proposals){ if(!req.allowed_fields.includes(p.field)) throw new Error(`AI proposed forbidden field ${p.field}`); if(typeof p.confidence!=='number' || p.confidence<0 || p.confidence>1) throw new Error('Invalid AI confidence'); } return [{json:{policy_id:req.policy_id,transaction_id:req.transaction_id,provider:'n8n-openai',proposals}}];
